name: coap_observe_sequence
description: CoAP Observe sequence number validation per RFC 7641 Section 4.4. 24-bit rollover and reordering semantics.

vectors.name: observe_seq_increasing_accept
vectors.description: Notification with higher sequence number is accepted.

vectors.name: observe_seq_equal_reject
vectors.description: Notification with same sequence number is rejected (duplicate).

vectors.name: observe_seq_lower_reject
vectors.description: Notification with lower sequence number is rejected (out of order).

vectors.name: observe_seq_rollover_24bit
vectors.note: Max 24-bit value 0xFFFFFF (16777215) rolls to 0. Comparisons use modular arithmetic.

vectors.name: observe_seq_rollover_backward_reject
vectors.description: After rollover, old seq 16777200 is rejected (appears newer but is old).
vectors.note: 16777200 > 10 numerically, but in 24-bit modular space with last_seq=10, this is behind.

vectors.name: observe_seq_exceeds_24bit_reject
vectors.description: Sequence number > 16777215 (24-bit max) is invalid option value.

vectors.name: observe_seq_large_jump_accept
vectors.description: Large forward jump within half-range is valid (RFC 7641 comparison).
vectors.note: Half of 2^24 is 8388608. Jump of ~8.3M is just under half.

vectors.name: observe_seq_beyond_half_range_reject
vectors.description: Jump beyond half 24-bit range is considered backwards.
